draft.title: Leonardo and Michelangelo
card: Leonardo da Vinci (1452 to 1519) was an artist who also studied science. He dissected bodies to learn how they work, and he drew plans for machines such as flying devices.
Leonardo painted the Mona Lisa. His notebooks show that he treated art, science and invention as linked ways of understanding the world.
Michelangelo Buonarroti (1475 to 1564) was a sculptor and painter. He carved the marble statue of David, which shows the human body in great detail.
Michelangelo also painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel in Rome. Both men are seen as Renaissance masters because their work showed what human skill could do.
draft.remember: Leonardo joined art with science and invention. Michelangelo is known for the Sistine Chapel ceiling and the statue of David.

a.q: Which description best fits Leonardo da Vinci's work?
opts: He joined art with science and invention
He was known mainly for carving marble statues
He ran a bank that paid for other artists' work
He invented the printing press used for books
a.why: Leonardo painted, but he also studied bodies and designed machines, so his work linked art with science and invention. Carving marble is the best known work of Michelangelo, not Leonardo.
a.clue: Think about his notebooks of bodies and machines.

b.q: A museum in Melbourne shows a huge marble statue of a young man, carved in Florence, and a painted ceiling in a chapel in Rome. Whose work are these?
opts: Michelangelo, who carved David and painted a chapel ceiling
Leonardo, who carved David and painted a chapel ceiling
Michelangelo, who painted the Mona Lisa and drew machines
Leonardo, who painted the Mona Lisa and drew machines
b.why: The statue of David and the Sistine Chapel ceiling are both works by Michelangelo. Leonardo is the one who painted the Mona Lisa and drew machines, so the options that name him for David are wrong.
b.clue: Which man was a sculptor as well as a painter?

a.best: He joined art with science and invention

b.best: Michelangelo, who carved David and painted a chapel ceiling
